summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtins helper. Verified: tests/unit/test_args.py, test_regions.py and test_client.py pass (415 tests) using the generator venv. Caveats: black/isort are not installed in the venv, so formatting was checked by hand; a pre-existing 82-column line in args.py (around line 315) was left alone; dict keys are enum members, so string-keyed lookup will not work; regions.py changed on disk mid-session and I confirmed my enum is still present but did not review the other change. Nothing committed.
